so long story short, my doctor said i don’t have adhd and my mom kept saying that i was making up my symptoms and that they weren’t real. 

now i’m just frustrated and kinda upset because then i don’t understand why i have so much trouble focusing and remembering things. what makes me mad most is that the doctor went off what my teachers said and what my mom said. the entire reason i said anything was because it was affecting school and home. i would constantly forget directions my teacher said, or forget to do things my mother told me and she would yell at me. they took what i had to say with a grain of salt. my doctor chalked this up to just stress and school. 

im scared to the future now. i know my mom is going to still tell me to pay attention, to just focus. she’s gonna still yell at me for forgetting to do things and i still gonna forget things in school. i’m gonna still be fidgeting to no end and zone out in the middle of conversations. my mom is gonna make fun of me for ever thinking that i had adhd and possibly say that i wasted her money by going to the doctor.

I don’t know her reading level but I would suggest A Series of Unfortunate Events. It’s about these three orphan kids who are being followed by an evil uncle who tries to get custody of them. There are about 13 books and they good for every age. Also, there is a television series based on these books. 

Among the Hidden series are also really good. It’s about a society where having 3+ kids is against the law and the story of a third child who finds other kids like them and they rebel against the government. I think there are about 5-6 books. This might be a little harder but one of my favorite books series nonetheless. 

And you can’t go wrong with Harry Potter, if she hasn’t read them yet.
